title: Spyglass Officially Launched
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, empowering all users with its powerful features and insightful capabilities.

title: Enhanced File and Image Management
summary: Users now have comprehensive control over how images and other files are uploaded, managed, and visually presented within the editor, making content creation more flexible and intuitive.

title: Discover Our Public Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap provides complete transparency into our product development, revealing recently shipped features, upcoming updates, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive experience with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, draggable, and seamlessly integrated with our updated visual style.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience more fluid and intuitive teamwork with significant enhancements to our real-time collaboration tools.

title: Enhanced Sharing and Collaboration
summary: Collaborate effortlessly on your ideas and quests with significantly improved visibility and utility of all your shared content.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Unlock Noeko's full potential for a global audience with comprehensive support for numerous international languages.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with greater control and direct contribution opportunities.

title: Enhanced Knowledge Network for Deeper Insights
summary: Transform your knowledge network into a powerful hub for discovery and collaboration with dynamic filtering by tags, time, and shared content, making exploration more intuitive and insightful.

title: Powerful Search Filters & Custom Collections
summary: Unlock your knowledge with powerful new filters and sorting options, allowing you to precisely narrow down and save custom collections of information for quick access.

title: Smarter Note Connections
summary: This feature allows you to better organize your notes by providing richer, interactive ways to view and engage with linked content.

title: Introducing Noeko Self-Hosting and Premium Features
summary: We are excited to launch Noeko with new self-hosting options and flexible paid plans, giving you enhanced control and access to advanced capabilities.

title: Stunning New & Improved Themes
summary: We're enhancing the visual experience by refining our current themes and introducing a vibrant collection of new ones, ensuring a beautiful and customizable interface for every user.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're ensuring that your homepage always greets you with the correct time of day, providing a more precise and welcoming start to your experience.

title: Quick Actions for Your Lists
summary: Effortlessly manage your lists and tags by performing common actions like removing items or deleting entries directly from any list view, saving you valuable time and clicks.

title: Diverse Content Integration
summary: Unlock the full potential of your information by seamlessly integrating diverse content types, such as YouTube videos, websites, and text, directly into your workflow.
